# GQ

> GQ is the premier destination for men's fashion, style, grooming, wellness, and entertainment coverage featuring celebrity interviews, trend analysis, and expert product recommendations.

GQ serves as a comprehensive lifestyle authority for men, covering everything from high-fashion menswear trends and grooming advice to celebrity culture, sports, and entertainment news. The site combines editorial expertise with curated product recommendations and exclusive celebrity interviews.

## Core Content Hubs

- [GQ Homepage](https://www.gq.com): GQ homepage featuring men's fashion, style, grooming, fitness, entertainment and lifestyle content
- [Men's Style & Fashion](https://www.gq.com/style): GQ's men's fashion and style hub with trends, tips, celebrity style and expert advice
- [Culture](https://www.gq.com/culture): GQ's entertainment, celebrity and sports news with reviews and expert coverage
- [GQ Sports](https://www.gq.com/gqsports): GQ Sports covering stylish athletes, interviews and sports culture beyond the field

## Style & Grooming Guides

- [Men's Grooming](https://www.gq.com/grooming): Men's grooming guide covering hairstyles, skincare, beard care and product reviews
- [GQ Recommends](https://www.gq.com/gq-recommends): Editor-curated product recommendations for menswear, gear, sales and gift ideas
- [Best T-Shirts for Men 2026](https://www.gq.com/story/best-t-shirts-for-every-situation): GQ's essential guide to best men's t-shirts from budget to luxury options
- [Approach Shoes Trend Guide](https://www.gq.com/story/how-approach-shoes-summited-the-mainstream): Guide to approach shoes trend and recommendations for men's footwear

## Celebrity Style & Interviews

- [Niall Horan: Love, Loss, and Growing Up](https://www.gq.com/story/niall-horan-gq-hype): Niall Horan interview about new album 'Dinner Party' and personal growth
- [CyHi the Prynce Interview](https://www.gq.com/story/cyhi-the-prynce-finally-goes-on-the-record): CyHi the Prynce interview on Kanye West, G.O.O.D. Music and hip-hop
- [Riz Ahmed: James Bond in Streetwear](https://www.gq.com/story/riz-ahmed-bait-james-bond-press-tour-style): Riz Ahmed's press tour styling for Amazon series 'Bait' with streetwear focus
- [Robert Pattinson's Stylish Dad Shoes](https://www.gq.com/story/robert-pattinson-clarks-desert-trek-shoes): Robert Pattinson's Clarks boots style feature and dad fashion trend analysis

## Fashion & Entertainment Features

- [GQ Men of the Year 2025](https://www.gq.com/men-of-the-year): GQ's annual Men of the Year 2025 celebration with red carpet coverage and honorees
- [Fall 2026 Menswear Shows Roundup](https://www.gq.com/story/the-coolest-stuff-gqs-fashion-director-saw-at-the-fall-2026-menswear-shows): Fashion director's picks from Fall 2026 menswear shows featuring luxury designers
- [Heat 2 Cast Updates](https://www.gq.com/story/the-heat-2-cast-is-shaping-up-heres-everything-we-know): Casting news and updates for Michael Mann's Heat 2 sequel film

## Health, Wellness & Lifestyle
